1_1_1.title: Defamatory or Discriminatory
1_1_1.desc: Content that is defamatory, discriminatory, or mean-spirited, including references or commentary about religion, race, sexual orientation, gender, national/ethnic origin, or other targeted groups.

1_1_2.title: Violence
1_1_2.desc: Realistic depictions of physical harm or violence against people or animals. Content that encourages self-harm or illegal acts.

1_1_3.title: Sexual Content
1_1_3.desc: Overtly sexual or pornographic material, including "adult-themed" plugins.

1_1_4.title: Harassment
1_1_4.desc: Features designed to facilitate doxxing, stalking, or targeted harassment of server players.

1_2_1.title: Malware
1_2_1.desc: Plugins must not contain any malicious code. This includes viruses, backdoors, hidden "OP" commands, or any code that performs actions without the server owner's knowledge.

1_2_2.title: Phishing
1_2_2.desc: Plugins must not attempt to steal user credentials, tokens (like Discord tokens), or any sensitive configuration files from the server host.

1_2_3.title: Remote Execution
1_2_3.desc: Plugins must not download and execute arbitrary code from external sources that was not included in the original WASM binary approved by the market.

1_3_1.title: Transparency
1_3_1.desc: If your plugin sends data to an external server (e.g., for analytics or licensing), you must disclose this clearly in the description.

1_3_2.title: Opt-out
1_3_2.desc: All telemetry or external reporting must provide a configuration option to be disabled.

1_3_3.title: Sensitive Files
1_3_3.desc: Plugins must not access or upload files outside of their designated data folder without clear justification and disclosure.

2_1_1.title: Minimum Functionality
2_1_1.desc: Plugins must provide a meaningful extension to the server experience. Trivial single-command wrappers, "empty" plugins, or low-effort/unreviewed AI-generated scripts will be rejected.

2_1_2.title: Stability
2_1_2.desc: Plugins that cause the server to crash or hang during normal operation will be removed.

2_2_1.title: Screenshots
2_2_1.desc: Screenshots must accurately reflect the plugin's actual interface, custom UI/web panel, or effects in-game. Do not use unrelated stock images or deceptive AI-generated artwork in place of real screenshots.

2_2_2.title: Categorization
2_2_2.desc: Plugins must be placed in the most relevant category. Miscategorizing to gain visibility is a violation.

2_2_3.title: Descriptions
2_2_3.desc: Do not include irrelevant keywords or "tag spam" in your description to manipulate search results.

2_3_1.title: CPU usage
2_3_1.desc: Avoid blocking the main server thread. Use asynchronous tasks where possible.

2_3_2.title: Memory leaks
2_3_2.desc: Ensure your WASM binary does not leak memory over long runtimes.

3_1_1.title: Integrated Payments
3_1_1.desc: All transactions for plugins must go through the PumpkinMarket system. Linking to Patreon, PayPal, or other external payment sites within the plugin or description is not allowed.

3_1_2.title: Digital Goods
3_1_2.desc: Plugins must not unlock features via external "keys" or "codes" purchased outside the market.

3_2_1.title: Bait and Switch
3_2_1.desc: Plugins must not change their primary purpose after approval or hide essential features behind unexpected paywalls.

3_2_2.title: Fake Reviews
3_2_2.desc: Developers found to be inflating their own ratings or reviews will be permanently banned.

3_2_3.title: Scamming
3_2_3.desc: Any plugin found to be a scam or "vaporware" will result in an immediate permanent ban and possible refunding of all affected users.

4_1_1.title: Originality
4_1_1.desc: Competing plugins in existing categories are welcome when they offer meaningful improvements (better performance, richer configuration, database support, or active maintenance). Barebones clones or template-level duplicates that offer less functionality than established plugins will be rejected.

4_1_2.title: Spam
4_1_2.desc: Do not upload multiple near-identical plugins or mass-generated AI submissions. Consolidate features into a single, high-quality plugin with configuration options.

4_2_1.title: Consistency
4_2_1.desc: We recommend following standard command patterns (e.g., /pluginname help) to ensure a familiar experience for users.

4_2_2.title: Documentation
4_2_2.desc: Provide clear instructions in your description or a linked wiki. Plugins that are impossible to configure or use will be rejected.

5_1.title: Intellectual Property
5_1.desc: You must be the original author of the code or have the legal right to distribute it. Using leaked or stolen code ("leaks") will result in an immediate ban.

5_2.title: Open Source Licenses
5_2.desc: If your plugin includes open-source components, you must adhere to the terms of those licenses. Include necessary attributions and license files within your plugin archive.

5_3.title: Right to Remove
5_3.desc: PumpkinMarket reserves the right to remove any plugin at its sole discretion if it is determined to be detrimental to the market's reputation or user safety, even if a specific guideline has not been technically violated.

page.lede: High-quality plugins for a high-quality community.
page.footer: We hope these guidelines help you build better plugins and a better PumpkinMarket. We’re excited to see what you create!
page.intro: Plugins are a great way to extend the functionality of PumpkinMC servers. Our goal is to provide a safe experience for users and a great opportunity for every developer to succeed. We’ve developed these Review Guidelines to help you through the development process.
page.before_submit_1: Ensure your plugin is complete and functional.
page.before_submit_2: Test for crashes and server performance impact.
page.before_submit_3: Check that all links, icons, and metadata are accurate and final.
page.before_submit_4: Verify that your plugin follows all security best practices.
page.safety_lead: When users download a plugin from PumpkinMarket, they need to be certain that it is safe to do so. Your plugin should not contain self-replicating code, backdoors, or any features that could harm a server or its data.
page.group_1_1_lead: Plugins should not include content that is offensive, insensitive, upsetting, intended to disgust, or in exceptionally poor taste. Examples of such content include:
page.group_1_2_lead: PumpkinMarket is dedicated to the prevention of "griefing" and malicious exploitation at the platform level.
page.group_1_3_lead: Data privacy is a fundamental right. Plugins must be transparent about data collection.
page.performance_lead: Users expect plugins to be reliable and efficient. Unoptimized plugins can crash servers or cause significant lag, leading to a poor user experience.
page.group_2_1_lead: PumpkinMarket will reject plugins that are not yet complete. We do not accept "placeholder" plugins or versions that are non-functional.
page.group_2_2_lead: The information you provide about your plugin must be accurate and honest.
page.group_2_3_lead: PumpkinMC servers run in high-concurrency environments. Performance is critical.
page.business_lead: Monetization on PumpkinMarket should be transparent and provide clear value to the user.
page.design_lead: A great plugin is more than just code; it's also about how it's presented and how users interact with it.
page.legal_lead: You are responsible for ensuring your plugin complies with all applicable laws and regulations.
